messages:
Zara: FYI I opened a compact PR that adds a "Short-Sequence Playbook" to Optimize: prefetch toggles, quant-profile recipes, migration checklist, and small SDK snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/978
Theo: Nice. Can you include a public-safe prefetch utility instead of linking internal helpers? Ops flagged private links in the last review.
Zara: Yep  I'll paste a 40-line helper into docs/examples/prefetch_helper.py and reference it. Draft included in the PR.
Kendall: Add an explicit rule-of-thumb: "Disable KV-prefetch for routes with median_seq_len < 48 or for cold-start traffic until warmed." That saved Ops a few incidents.
Zara: Added that under "When to disable prefetch". Also added a tiny diagnostic script `prefetch_diagnose.py` that logs p95 delta with/without prefetch.
Rakesh: On quant notes: call out the known q4_1 short-prompt instability on models X/Y and recommend q8_0 or fp16 fallback for <32 tokens.
Zara: Done  included a short matrix comparing q8_0/q4_1/fp16 across token buckets and a one-liner: "Prefer fp16 for safety-critical exact-match-sensitive flows."
Theo: Can we add two canary recipes (conservative and standard) and the JSON examples for both? Ops likes concrete percentages.
Zara: Added: conservative (5%->20%->50%->100%) and standard (10%->40%->100%), plus suggested monitors: latency_p95, token_cost_delta, exact_match_regression.
Kendall: Small SDK compat note: BatchClient names changed across 0.9.x->0.10.x. Add a compatibility footnote and a tiny migration snippet.
Zara: Added compatibility notes for Python/Go/JS and an example fallback: `if sdk_version < "0.10.0": use legacy BatchClientV1`.
docs-bot: @Zara created JIRA-OPT-501 (docs: short-seq playbook + public helper + canary recipes) :bell:
Rakesh: Please also add the Console query we use to detect token-alignment regressions (pseudo): `SELECT sample_id, alignment_score FROM evals WHERE profile='short_seq' ORDER BY alignment_score ASC LIMIT 50`.
Zara: Included that as a "Verify alignment" step in the checklist. Also added a short script to synthesize a 2k sample set for p95/p99 validation.
Theo: I'll review the quant wording tomorrow morning and leave inline comments. If all good, we can merge Friday morning.
Zara: Thanks  aiming to address comments by EOD tonight. Will keep the PR open.
